prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Scrap Car Runner Garage CONCEPT ONLY, owner review reference, not production/runtime pixels.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: Concept B chosen by owner. Image2 is C only as a reference for restraint/low detail; DO NOT copy its blank wall-like backdrop, monochrome atmosphere, sky removal or structure. Image3 is the approved Golden Rustbucket shape/pixel style benchmark. Image4 is approved Golden Run atmospheric context, not a new scene to copy.
Primary request: refine B while unmistakably retaining B's open-air scrapyard service-bay identity. Keep B's spatial layout, side-view Rustbucket, test platform, light canopy, hanging lamp and airy blue outdoor mood. Calm B's roof/background noise and sky by simplifying value/shape groups. This is a surgical refinement, NOT a redesign or new scene.
HARD INVARIANTS: preserve the Rustbucket in image1 exactly in silhouette, orientation, placement, size, teal cabin, rust pickup bed, gray right-facing hood, small T1 engine, crooked antenna, dark wheels, highlights and all mechanical detailing. Do NOT repaint/reinvent car, change tier or make perspective/isometric. Keep the low roller bed and visible roller contact under each tire. Keep small rear exhaust indicating engine running/tested in place. Car is the only crisp high-contrast saturated hero. Preserve three tiny blue/orange/pale-steel status signals below platform as concept-only placeholders, no new gauges or labels. Preserve B's thin edge support posts, upper-right hanging task lamp with short cable, uneven corrugated canopy and open sides. No added props.
EDIT ROOF: keep the SAME light canopy silhouette and framing geometry; simplify surface treatment to 3-4 broad dull-steel/rust material patches. Remove fine corrugation striping, speckling, small rust pixels and excessive contrasting seams. Only a few deliberate chunky corrugation/shadow runs and quiet chipped edges. Reduce patch contrast/rust saturation enough to subordinate roof to car, not by turning shelter into an empty geometric diagram. The structure should still feel patched, salvaged and handmade.
EDIT DISTANT YARD: replace the busy many-silhouette horizon with just TWO OR THREE low muted dusty blue-gray grouped junkyard shapes near horizon, such as overlapping wrecked-car shells and one sparse broken shed outline. Retain scrapyard identity and clearly outdoor depth, but very low contrast and no fine tiny rooflines/cables, no new cranes or poles. Keep pale clear AIR behind the hero silhouette, no dark mass directly behind cabin/engine, no whole highway, no giant junk pile.
EDIT SKY: retain B's blue-to-pale outdoor atmosphere, more muted and calm than B. Remove most clouds. At most ONE small restrained pale cloud cluster at distant left horizon; leave most sky clear. No large cloud bands, elaborate gradient texture, distant city, painted sky detail or dramatic lighting. Do NOT use C's solid gray/cream wall. Viewer must read through the bay into an open yard, with sky and quiet distant depth.
EDIT REAR PANEL: short low worn corrugated service-yard panel remains below car's cabin/window, interrupted/receding at edges to reinforce open sides. Reduce striped texture; few broad material values. NEVER extend into a full normal wall behind vehicle.
EDIT FLOOR: preserve support plane and perspective already in B but remove hairline cracks, granular specks and scattered rust/gravel confetti. Broad calm cool gray/dark steel plane; only two or three worn edge marks away from center. Bottom quarter reserved calm for future navigation.
Style: keep coarse readable pixel-art clusters, chunky handmade scrapyard mechanical language as accepted references. Crisp square pixels, no extra painted/pseudo-pixel noise, antialiasing, blur, neon, bloom or glossy realism. Same upper-right daylight as car, lamp secondary. Warm dust/steel environment, teal reserved for hero, small signal accents only. Same portrait3:4 image framing as B, one unlabeled scene.
No text anywhere: no game title/logo, captions, labels, TEST ROLLERS, nav text, watermarks or signs. No new UI design, inventory grids, toolshelves, garage equipment panels or production sprite sheet.
Outcome: B's alive open-air scrapyard canopy + C's restraint, with the unchanged car/platform commanding the middle.
